tools.name: search_flights
tools.rich: Flights between two airports on one departure date, with times, airlines and prices. Not for the live status of a flight, and not for trains.

params.name: origin
params.rich: Departure airport as a three-letter IATA code.

params.name: destination
params.rich: Arrival airport as a three-letter IATA code.

params.name: date
params.rich: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: passengers
params.rich: Number of travellers, 1 to 9. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.rich: Live status of one flight on one date: scheduled and expected times, gate and delay. Not for finding flights and not for seats.

params.name: flight_number
params.rich: Two-letter airline code followed by the number, with no space.

params.name: date
params.rich: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: search_trains
tools.rich: Train departures between two cities on one date, with times, changes and fares. Not for flights, and not for a plain distance.

params.name: origin
params.rich: City the train leaves from.

params.name: destination
params.rich: City the train arrives in.

params.name: date
params.rich: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_driving_distance
tools.rich: Shortest road distance between two places, as a single figure. Not for directions or driving time, and not for straight-line distance.

params.name: origin
params.rich: Starting place, written as a city name.

params.name: destination
params.rich: End place, written as a city name.

params.name: unit
params.rich: Preferred unit of distance. Defaults to km.

tools.name: get_driving_directions
tools.rich: Turn-by-turn driving directions between two places, with the total driving time and the main roads. Not for the distance alone.

params.name: origin
params.rich: Starting place, written as a city name.

params.name: destination
params.rich: End place, written as a city name.

tools.name: get_geo_distance
tools.rich: Straight-line distance between two places, not along roads. For the distance by road use the driving distance tool; for public transport use the transit distance tool.

params.name: start_location
params.rich: Starting place, written as city and state, such as Austin, TX.

params.name: end_location
params.rich: End place, written as city and state, such as Austin, TX.

params.name: units
params.rich: Distance units, 'miles' or 'kilometers'. Defaults to miles.

tools.name: get_transit_distance
tools.rich: Shortest distance between two cities by public transport, optionally allowing changes between vehicles. Not for timetables or fares, and not for a particular date.

params.name: start_city
params.rich: City the journey starts in.

params.name: end_city
params.rich: City the journey ends in.

params.name: transportation
params.rich: Preferred mode of public transport. Defaults to bus.

params.name: allow_transfer
params.rich: True to allow changing between vehicles. Defaults to false.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.rich: Hotels with a free room in one city for a stay starting on a given date, with nightly prices. Not for an existing reservation.

params.name: city
params.rich: City to stay in.

params.name: check_in
params.rich: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: nights
params.rich: Number of nights, 1 to 30.

params.name: guests
params.rich: Number of guests, 1 to 6. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.rich: Details of an existing reservation by its reference: travellers, dates and status. Not for finding new flights or hotels.

params.name: booking_reference
params.rich: Booking reference: BK- then six letters or digits.

tools.name: get_seat_map
tools.rich: Free and taken seats on one flight on one date, by row, with the seat types. Not for flight times or bags.

params.name: flight_number
params.rich: Two-letter airline code followed by the number, with no space.

params.name: date
params.rich: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_baggage_allowance
tools.rich: Free checked and carry-on bags, with weight limits, for one flight in one cabin. Not for seat choice.

params.name: flight_number
params.rich: Two-letter airline code followed by the number, with no space.

params.name: cabin
params.rich: Cabin class: economy, business or first.

tools.name: get_airport_info
tools.rich: Name, three-letter code, city, number of terminals and distance from the city centre for one airport. Not for flights from or to it.

params.name: airport
params.rich: Airport name, such as Gatwick.

tools.name: get_visa_requirements
tools.rich: Whether a traveller of one nationality needs a visa for a country, and the permitted length of stay. Not for booking or applying.

params.name: nationality
params.rich: Country that issued the passport, such as Portugal.

params.name: destination_country
params.rich: Country being entered.

tools.name: search_rental_cars
tools.rich: Rental cars available in a city from a pickup date for a number of days, with daily prices. Not for taxis or transfers.

params.name: city
params.rich: City to pick the car up in.

params.name: pickup_date
params.rich: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: days
params.rich: Rental length in days, 1 to 30.
